title.narrative: Provision of GBV Services to Drought Affected IDPs and Host community Population in Berdale , Southwest state of Somalia.

description.narrative:
ltpgtltfont color="#000000" face="Arial, sans-serif"gtIn response the growing the humanitarian needs in the country due to the devastating drought situation SOS CVS is proposing holistic gender-based violence lt/fontgtltfont color="#000000" face="Arial, sans-serif"gtinterventions with aim of preventing, mitigating and responding acute gender-based violence needs of the affected populations in Berdale district of Bay region. The proposed project will target 15 IDP sites within Berdale some of the which are located outside the town. lt/fontgtlt/pgtltpgtltfont color="#000000" face="Arial, sans-serif"gtThe main objective of the proposed GBV project is to address holistically preventing and respond to the high prevalence GBV incidents acute protection needs by providing prevention and responsive interventions. The GBV intervention of the project are design to support women and adolescent girls with the responsive GBV services including the provision of comprehensive GBV Case Management support, PSS services, clinical management of rape, provision unconditional cash support and dignity kits as well as creation of structured awareness campaigns on the prevention on GBV risks and concerns in the targeted communities. lt/fontgtlt/pgtltpgtltfont color="#000000" face="Arial, sans-serif"gtltbrgtlt/fontgtlt/pgtltpgtltfont color="#000000" face="Arial, sans-serif"gtThe project will directly target a total 10,800 Beneficiaries (4400 women 4400 girls 1000 Men and 1000 Boys) Majority of these target beneficiaries are newly drought displaced IDPs in 15 IDP camps in and around Berdale town as well as host community members. lt/fontgtltspan style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0) font-family: Arial, sans-serif"gtSOS will target the following IDP sites Kulmiye Liban Maykoo Guraw Midnimo Minfuray Moorabus NasibRaardawo Raydabale Sinan Tawakal Toosikaar Toosile Towfiq Wadaajir. lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltfont color="#000000" face="Arial, sans-serif"gt
